hypothesis: Gradually replacing a long-history replay bank preserves a useful bounded-adaptive-feedback learning advantage while avoiding more than2pp old-fact loss against equally replayed frozen feedback.
primary_metric: Per-seed equal mean of novel CE at steps544..768 every32 and drift CE at1056..1280 every32 (16 checkpoints); arithmetic mean of three paired relative CE reductions.
minimum_useful_effect: Mean relative CE reduction>=5%; every seed>=0%.
success_rule: All finite/fidelity/data/replay/preservation gates, mean CE reduction>=5% and no negative seed; adaptive_refreshed old-window and final-old accuracy at most2pp worse than frozen_refreshed in every seed.
futility_rule: No tuning or added seeds. Stop on fidelity, preservation, pilot numerical failure or exhausted budget; preserve all failed arms. Main arm failure invalidates the primary gate. Retention or effect failure means no promotion.

design.control_rationale: Three learning policies crossed with FIFO, permanent mixed bank and causally refreshed mixed bank. Refresh-versus-permanent shares initial512 examples, allocation256+256,8+8 samples, current stream, recent queue and replay draws; only bank replacement differs. Refresh RNG independent. All arms share model, starts, LR/decay and exposure. No magnitude normalization or replay rate tuning.
design.seed_selection_method: Fresh consecutive main seeds901801..3; separate mechanical pilot98997. New refresh verification98997/13817/22817 and byte-preserved predecessor verification seeds97987/12817/21817. No seed/world search or exclusions.
design.matching_track: Same model/start/lr/decay/exposure/replay count/storage, one configuration, no selection. Replay content is treatment; FIFO additionally differs in memory allocation. Learning methods have different measured compute costs.
design.compute_accounting: Shared warmup once per seed; imports, SVD caps, schedule regeneration, diagnostics, all full online replays and analysis startup charged. Per-worker RSS; aggregate peak, FLOPs and deployment latency unmeasured.

training.updates: Main:4096 shared warmup and2048 online updates per arm; pilot4096+256. Four phases of512 main/64 pilot.
training.target_exposures_per_trial: Warmup1048576 binary targets per seed; main online262144 per arm; pilot32768. No extra updates for old anchors; duplicate replay adds no new information.
training.tokens_per_update: No language tokens; warmup64x4 targets, online32x4.
training.microbatch: Warmup64; online16 current+16 replay. FIFO16 recent; both mixed modes8 recent+8 bank.
training.bptt_length: Not applicable: feedforward model, no BPTT.
training.accessible_history: All512 memory rows. FIFO expires after32 batches; both mixed recent queues after16. Permanent bank never expires. Refreshed bank circularly replaces1 row per online batch using a uniform current example; after initial256 updates, all bank samples are1..256 updates old. Samples use only past batches; labels remain historically observed.
training.state_carry_and_detach: Persistent forward/feedback matrices, detached stateless SGD; no optimizer/shadow state. Replay memory holds512 rows; refresh adds only a counter/RNG stream. Complete precomputed benchmark streams are research bookkeeping, not measured deployment memory.
training.document_reset_policy: Not applicable: synthetic contexts, no documents.
training.optimizer_schedule: Unchanged lr.05, feedback multiplier.8, WD W/B .001 and V/U .01. Spectral cap2 initially and after feedback updates with margin1-4eps; no magnitude normalization.
training.checkpoint_selection_rule: No selection; all registered windows and final state reported. NPZ stores shared warmup W/F, every final W and final adaptive F; BP/frozen F reference unchanged warmup. All4 phase/final complete-state hashes checked by replay.

evaluation.primary_endpoint: Per-seed equal mean of novel CE at steps544..768 every32 and drift CE at1056..1280 every32 (16 checkpoints); arithmetic mean of three paired relative CE reductions.
evaluation.duplicate_policy: All9 arms in pilot and all3 main seeds replay their entire online stream from serialized common warmup and independently regenerated/hash-verified schedules. Four phase and final complete-state hashes plus final stored tensors must match bitwise.
evaluation.uncertainty_method: Three paired seeds, report every result, mean and sample SD. Descriptive evidence only; no significance or population claim.
evaluation.multiple_comparison_policy: Only adaptive_refreshed versus frozen_refreshed is primary. Adaptive/frozen permanent and FIFO are secondary controls. Within-policy refreshed-minus-permanent, refreshed-minus-FIFO, permanent-minus-FIFO; replay/learning interactions; novel/drift endpoint decomposition; BP and direction probes are descriptive. No favorable comparator selection.
